properties.displayName: Alert Event ASIM parser for TrendAI VisionOne
properties.query:
let parser = (
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
){
TrendAI_XDR_WORKBENCH_V2_CL
| where not(disabled)
| project-rename 
    EventStartTime = createdTime_t
    , EventEndTime = updatedTime_t
    , EventUid = workbenchId_s
    , EventSeverity = severity_s
    , EventMessage = description_s
    , EventOwner = xdrCustomerID_g
    , RuleName = model_s
    , AlertName = workbenchName_s
    , ThreatName = MalwareName_s
    , EventReportUrl = workbenchLink_s
| extend
    EventResult = "Success"
    , EventType = "Alert"
    , EventVendor = "TrendAI"
    , EventProduct = "Vision One"
    , EventSchema = "AlertEvent"
    , EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
    , EventCount = int(1)
    , ThreatRiskLevel = toint(priorityScore_d)
    , RuleNumber = toint(modelId_g)
    , AlertOriginalStatus = alertStatus_s
| extend 
    AlertStatus = 
        case(
            alertStatus_s in~("new","in_progress"), "Active",
            alertStatus_s =~ "resolved", "Closed",
            "Active"
        )
    , AlertVerdict = 
        case(
            investigationResult_s =~ "True Positive", "True Positive",
            investigationResult_s =~ "False Positive", "False Positive",
            investigationResult_s has "Benign", "Benign Positive",
            "Unknown"
        )
//parse host and user
| mv-apply entities on (
    extend type = tostring(entities.entityType)
    | extend value = entities.entityValue
    | summarize value = make_list(value) by type
    | summarize entities = make_bag(bag_pack(type, value))
)
| extend 
    Username = coalesce(UserAccountName_s, tostring(entities.account[0]))
    , DvcIpAddr = tostring(entities.host[0].ips[0])
    , host_ = coalesce(HostHostName_s, tostring(entities.host[0].name))
| extend 
    DvcHostname = 
        case (
            host_ contains "\\", split(host_,"\\")[1],
            host_ contains ".", split(host_,".")[0],
            host_
        )
    , DvcDomain = 
        case (
            host_ contains "\\", split(host_,"\\")[0],
            host_ contains ".", tostring(strcat_array(array_slice(split(host_,"."), 1, -1), '.')),
            ""
        )
    , DvcDomainType = 
        case(
            host_ contains "\\", "Windows",
            host_ contains ".", "FQDN",
            ""
        )
    , UsernameType = 
        case(
            Username contains "@", "UPN",
            Username contains "\\", "Windows",
            Username contains "OU=", "DN",
            Username matches regex @"^\d{11}$","AWSId",
            "Simple"
        )
//parse indicators
| mv-apply indicators on (
    extend type = tostring(indicators.type)
    | extend value = tostring(indicators.value)
    | summarize value = make_list(value) by type
    | summarize indicators = make_bag(bag_pack(type, value))
)
| extend 
    ProcessCommandLine = coalesce(ProcessCommandLine_s, indicators.command_line)
    , FileName = coalesce(FileName_s, indicators.filename)
    , FilePath = coalesce(FileDirectory_s, indicators.fullpath)
    , FileSHA1 = tostring(indicators.file_sha1)
    , FileSHA256 = tostring(indicators.file_sha256)
    , Url = coalesce(URL_s, indicators.url)
    , RegistryKey = coalesce(RegistryKey_s, indicators.registry_key) 
    , RegistryValue = coalesce(RegistryValueName_s, indicators.registry_value)  
    , RegistryValueData = coalesce(RegistryValue_s, indicators.registry_value_data)  
//parse mitre
| mv-apply matched_rule = matchedRules on(
    extend mitre_id = matched_rule.matchedFilters[0].mitreTechniqueIds
    | summarize AttackTechniques = strcat_array(make_set(mitre_id),", ")
)
//additional details
| extend AdditionalFields = 
    iff(pack == true,
        bag_pack(
            "AlertTriggerTimestamp_t", alertTriggerTimestamp_t,
            "IncidentId", incidentId_s,
            "InvestigationStatus", investigationStatus_s,
            "AlertOriginalVerdict", investigationResult_s,
            "AlertProvider",alertProvider_s,
            "ModelType", modelType_s,
            "SchemaVersion", schemaVersion_s,
            "SourceSystem", SourceSystem,
            "TenantId", TenantId,
            "WorkbenchCompleteTimestamp", workbenchCompleteTimestamp_t,
            "UserAccountNTDomain", UserAccountNTDomain_s,
            "MailboxPrimaryAddress", MailboxPrimaryAddress_s,
            "FileHashValue",FileHashValue_s,
            "DomainNameIOC", DomainName_s,
            "IPAddressIOC", IPAddress,
            "ImpactScope", impactScope_s,
            "RawData", RawData,
            "Indicators", indicators,
            "Entities", entities,
            "MatchedRules", matchedRules
        )
        , dynamic({}))
//alias
| extend 
    AlertDescription = EventMessage
    , AlertId = EventUid
    , Dvc = DvcHostname
    , Rule = RuleName
    , Hostname = DvcHostname
    , IpAddr = DvcIpAddr
    , User = Username
| project-away *_*,IPAddress,Computer,MG, ManagementGroupName,RawData,SourceSystem,TenantId, entities, indicators, matchedRules
| project-reorder
    TimeGenerated
    , EventSeverity
    , AlertId
    , AlertName
    , AlertDescription
    , AlertVerdict
    , AlertStatus
    , AlertOriginalStatus
    , ThreatRiskLevel
    , DvcHostname
    , DvcDomain
    , DvcDomainType
    , DvcIpAddr
    , Username
    , UsernameType
    , ProcessCommandLine
    , FileName
    , FilePath
    , FileSHA1
    , FileSHA256
    , Url
    , RegistryKey
    , RegistryValue
    , RegistryValueData
    , IpAddr
    , User
    , Rule
    , RuleNumber
    , RuleName
    , EventReportUrl
    , EventUid
    , EventType
    , EventCount
    , EventMessage
    , EventStartTime
    , EventEndTime
    , EventProduct
    , EventVendor
    , EventResult
    , EventSchema
    , EventSchemaVersion
    , Type
    , Dvc
    , Hostname
    , AdditionalFields 
};
parser
(
    disabled = disabled
    , pack = pack
)
